_comment: Seed document for Firestore collection: pricing_config, document ID: main

booking_tiers._tier3_formula_note: tier3_driver_commission = tier3_driver_commission_base + (per_km_overage_rate * (distanceKm - long_distance_limit_km)). per_km_overage_rate lives exclusively under booking_tiers — it is NOT shared with fare_formula. fare_formula uses per_km_rate (75) for the separate informational fare estimate. fareCalculator.js (Phase 2) is the single implementation of both formulas.

fare_formula._note: Fare is an informational estimate only — never collected by the platform. The full towing fare is paid directly by the customer to the driver.

cancellation_policy._note: Keys in forfeit_pct_by_count are strings because Firestore map keys are always strings. The cancellation handler looks up by String(monthlyCancelCount.count). The 1st cancellation is penalty-free (0% forfeited) per free_cancellations_per_month = 1; the 6th+ triggers the ban.
